name: Pinocchio
overview: For Veronica, lying has become the main skill in all aspects of her life. Like everyone else, she lied in order not to upset her parents, to remain a good friend and to avoid disappointment in relationships with guys. She was so successful at deception that she became a successful marketer at a controversial cosmetics company. And so Veronica meets Cyril, the perfect guy for her, with whom she could be herself. After that, she has an acute allergic reaction, and Veronica discovers that she can no longer lie.
